question:
Which of the following is the same as

\[\dfrac{2-4+6-8+10-12+14}{3-6+9-12+15-18+21}?\]
solution:
Pairing adjacent positive and negative terms makes both sums short. The numerator is
\[
(2-4)+(6-8)+(10-12)+14
=-2-2-2+14=8.
\]
The denominator is
\[
(3-6)+(9-12)+(15-18)+21
=-3-3-3+21=12.
\]
Since the denominator is nonzero, the expression equals
\[
\frac8{12}=\frac23,
\]
choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
